week34.0: Mwana, akafukidzwa nokuda kwokushaya nzvimbo, kazhinji kazhinji anochengeta makumbo ake akafukidzwa achitarira pachipfuva apo achiramba achifamba nguva dzose.
week34.3: Pasinei nokuti nzvimbo yacho yakaderera, kufamba kwomwana uye kuchinja kunoita dumbu rako kunowanzooneka.
week34.4: Kuramba uchitarisira kufamba kwomwana kwakadaro kunoramba kuchikosha kusvikira paakaberekwa.

week35.0: Mwana anoramba achizadza, izvo zvichavabatsira kudzora tembiricha yavo pavanenge vachangoberekwa.
week35.3: Kunyanya kusimba kwepeltvic kunogona kuoneka sezvo mwana achiderera zvishoma nezvishoma.
week35.4: Pasinei nenzvimbo shomanene, mwana anofanira kuramba achifamba nguva dzose sezvaaimboita mumavhiki apfuura.

week36.0: Mapapu anowanzova akura zvakakwana kuti abvumire kufema nokuzvimiririra, uye mwana anokwanisa kumedza nokudya.
week36.3: Dzimwe nguva unogona kunzwa kuti hausi kufema zvakanaka, sezvo chibereko chichitora nzvimbo yakawanda pasi pemabvi.
week36.4: Pamuviri panonzi panenge paine nguva yakazara pakati pevhiki 37 ne42.

week37.0: Mwana anoonekwa seakakura zvakakwana kuti aberekwe.
week37.3: Kunzwa kwokudzikira kwesimba remapfupa kunowanzoitika apo mwana anoenda kumapfupa.
week37.4: Kubva vhiki ino zvichienda mberi, nguva yokusununguka inoonekwa seyakwana uye kuberekwa kunogona kuitika chero nguva.

week38.0: Chikamu chakadzika chakanga chakafukidza ganda chakanyangarika, uye matumbo ari kuunganidza meconium, tsvina yokutanga yechizvarwa chitsva.
week38.3: Kuziva zviratidzo zvokubereka kunogona kubatsira sezvo kuberekwa kuswedera pedyo.
week38.4: Kana munhu akaberekwa asina kurapwa, kazhinji haakurudzirwi kuti aberekwe asati asvika vhiki 39.

week39.0: Ganda, raimbova rakapfava, rava kuoma uye rava kudzivirira mwana zviri nani.
week39.3: Kusashivirira uye kuneta kwakati kwakati zvinowanzoitika apo nguva yokuguma nguva inoswedera pedyo.
week39.4: Kuyerera kweropa kwomwana achangoberekwa kunoramba kuchigadziriswa pashure pokunge aberekwa, izvo zvinogona kupa maoko kana kuti tsoka ruvara rwebhuruu zvishoma kwenguva pfupi.

week40.0: Mwana wacho akura zvakakwana uye akagadzirira kuberekwa. Zuva rokuberekwa rinogona kufungidzirwa kuti kuberekwa kwakawanda kunoitika mumazuva ari pedyo naye, asati aberekwa kana kuti pashure.
week40.3: Kumirira zviratidzo zvokubereka (kuvhiringidzika nguva dzose, kuputswa kwemvura) kwakajairika munguva ino.
week40.4: Kufamba zvishoma kupfuura nguva yakatarwa kunoramba kuri kwakajairika uye hakurevi kuti pane dambudziko; kuongorora kwakadzama kunowanzopiwa.

week41.0: Mwana anoramba akura zvakakwana. Kunze kwedate rokuberekwa, kazhinji kazhinji kunoongororwa zviri pedyo kuti aone kuti mwana ari nani.
week41.1: Kumirira kwenguva refu kunogona kuuya nokuneta kwakakura uye kusashivirira.
week41.2: Kupfuura nguva yacho kunowanzoguma nokuwedzera kuongorora kweboka rezvokurapa.
